messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: inferpool-usw reported 3 nodes NotReady in 2m. Priority: P2. Links: <https://internal.ops/alerts/1748503210|alert-1748503210>
alex: saw alert, investigating. which AZ?
maria: US-WEST-2a. metrics show kubelet restarts on those nodes.
alex: thanks. reassigning to oncall. @sam you're up for infra today?
sam: oncall here, taking it. checking node statuses...
sam: `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep inferpool-usw` -> node-23 NotReady, node-24 NotReady, node-27 Ready but high load
jin: I'm seeing repeated docker/containerd OOMs in kubelet logs on node-23. snippet:
``
Mar 27 14:02:03 node-23 kubelet[1234]: runtime: failed to allocate memory: out of memory
Mar 27 14:02:04 node-23 kubelet[1234]: kubelet: container runtime crashed: exit status 137
```

sam: ok, cordoning node-23 and 24 now, then drain with `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: started cordon drain on node-23
sam: cordoned node-23, drain in progress. moving inference pods off; autoscaler should pick up.
alex: should we fallback traffic to smaller model variants to reduce memory pressure? maria any objections?
maria: yes, enable fallback routing to model-lite pool for 30m. I'll open a quick rollout policy change.
alex: @sam after drain, can you trigger a node restart (systemctl restart kubelet + docker)? suspect kernel leak.
sam: will do. restarting kubelet on node-23 now.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0454. Customer impact: increased latency for ~3% of requests in us-west, no errors reported yet.
nora: notif to support and PGs sent. Also toggled reduced concurrency on the API gateway for inferpool-usw.
sam: kubelet restarted, node-23 back to Ready. rebalancing pods. node-24 still NotReady, investigating power cycle with cloud.
alex: good. keep pagerduty updates short. if customer errors rise >1% escalate to P1.
pagerduty-bot: NOTE: automatic paging suppressed for this incident.
maria: rollback of recent runtime image candidate 2026-03-26-rc failed on node-24; planning to roll to stable image.
sam: draining node-24 succeeded, power-cycled, kernel logs show oom_killer before restart. pushing stable runtime image to that node now.
ops-bot: updated incident timeline. next check in 5m.
alex: thanks team. summary for postmortem: transient kubelet OOMs causing container runtime crashes on infer nodes, mitigation: cordon/drain, kubelet restart, fallback routing, runtime image rollback. start drafting postmortem once incident marked resolved.
